title: What is Server-Side Rendering (and Why Create React App doesn't support it)
description: What exactly is server-side rendering (SSR), and how is it different from client-side rendering (CSR)? What does it have to do with single-page (SPA) and multi-page (MPA) applications? What are the pros and cons of each, and why can't we use create-react-app for server-rendered apps? We will address these and many other questions in this video.  Probably the best explanation of SSR I've ever seen, by David over at Firebase https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GQzn7XRdzxY  SSR vs CSR https://medium.freecodecamp.org/what-exactly-is-client-side-rendering-and-hows-it-different-from-server-side-rendering-bd5c786b340d  SSR is winning https://medium.com/walmartlabs/the-benefits-of-server-side-rendering-over-client-side-rendering-5d07ff2cefe8  SPA vs MPA by Max at Academind https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F_BYg2QGsC0  Why put "script" tags at the end of "body" https://stackoverflow.com/questions/436411/where-should-i-put-script-tags-in-html-markup
